logline: A St. Louis reporter with a history of self-harm returns to her small Missouri hometown to cover the murders of two young girls, and finds her mother's house the most dangerous place she has ever been.

seasons.review_body: Sharp Objects aired on HBO across eight weeks in summer 2018 and earned 92 percent on Rotten Tomatoes from 128 reviews, with the consensus centred on Amy Adams's performance as Camille Preaker and the show's formal distinctiveness. Director Jean-Marc Vallee - working with the same impressionistic flash-cut technique he deployed on Big Little Lies - built an atmosphere of Southern Gothic dread in Wind Gap, Missouri that critics consistently described as sweaty and sensory-specific. Patricia Clarkson's Adora won particular praise; Richard Roeper called both lead performances among the best of the actresses' careers. The Metacritic score of 78 reflected a minority of critics who found the pace frustratingly slow. The final episode's post-credits scene produced one of the year's most discussed endings.

episode_reviews.title: Vanish
episode_reviews.review_body: Sharp Objects Season 1 Episode 1 'Vanish' aired July 8, 2018 on HBO as the premiere of the 8-episode limited series. Rotten Tomatoes holds the season at 92 percent from 128 critics. The Chicago Sun-Times cited Sharp Objects as containing 'some of the best performances Amy Adams and Patricia Clarkson have ever given.' The premiere establishes Camille Preaker's psychology through formal means rather than exposition: director Jean-Marc Vallee's flash-cut memory intrusions begin in the first minutes, and the Wind Gap setting assembles its social architecture as a pressure system before any plot mechanics become explicit. Adams carries every scene without visible effort - the performance is calibrated to convey damage without inviting sympathy, which is the precise balance the show's moral architecture requires.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere establishes Camille Preaker's psychology through form rather than exposition: Vallee's editing pattern of memory intrusions begins immediately, and Wind Gap's social architecture materialises as a pressure system before any plot mechanics engage. Adams carries every scene she is in without obvious effort.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Camille's first return to the family home - the architecture of dread condensed into a single threshold crossing.

episode_reviews.title: Milk
episode_reviews.review_body: Sharp Objects Season 1 Episode 8 'Milk' aired August 26, 2018 on HBO as the finale of the 8-episode series. Rotten Tomatoes holds the season at 92 percent from 128 critics. The Chicago Sun-Times identified Adams and Clarkson's performances as career highs; The Oregonian called the atmosphere 'sweaty, sensual, mesmerizing.' The finale resolves the murder mystery with a reveal that critics found earned and psychologically consistent; what follows in the post-credits sequence recontextualises the entire series and produced more critical discussion than any other television moment of 2018. Clarkson's performance in the episode's final act drew unanimous praise. The post-credits image is not an addendum - it is the show's actual final statement.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale's primary narrative resolves with a reveal that critics found earned and disturbing; the post-credits sequence recontextualises the entire series and produced more immediate critical debate than any other television moment of 2018. Clarkson's performance in the episode's final act drew unanimous praise.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The post-credits sequence - a brief image that changes the interpretive frame of everything that preceded it.

critic_note.text: HBO's wonderfully addictive eight-episode murder mystery - predominantly about character.
